prompts.title: SaaS Landing Page
prompts.text: Build a complete SaaS landing page (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS): hero with headline + subheading, feature grid (6-8 items) with icons, 3-tier pricing table, testimonial carousel, prominent CTAs. Colors: [PRIMARY] + [SECONDARY], minimal design, responsive, no external libraries.

prompts.title: Product Launch Page
prompts.text: Create a product launch landing page (vanilla): fullscreen hero, countdown timer, product showcase, 3-4 key benefit cards, early-access form with JS validation, social proof badges. Tone: urgency & excitement. Responsive, no frameworks.

prompts.title: Agency Portfolio Landing
prompts.text: Build an agency landing page (vanilla): impactful hero (text + mock image), 3-4 services overview sections, case studies grid (4-6 mock projects), 3 team profiles, contact form. Clean design, light hover animations, responsive.

prompts.title: Product Showcase Store
prompts.text: Develop e-commerce product page (vanilla): image gallery with thumbnails, size/color selectors, add-to-cart with counter, product description tabs, related products carousel, reviews mock section. Cart persistence: localStorage JSON. Mobile-first responsive.

prompts.title: Digital Product Storefront
prompts.text: Create digital product storefront (vanilla): product card grid, category filter, search bar (client-side), cart sidebar, simple checkout form. Flow: add to cart → checkout → success page. Data: local JSON, localStorage for session.

prompts.title: Developer Portfolio
prompts.text: Build developer portfolio (vanilla): animated hero intro, skills section with progress bars, projects grid with tags + demo links, GitHub stats mock, brief about, contact form. Dark/light theme toggle via JS. Responsive.

prompts.title: Photographer Portfolio
prompts.text: Create photographer portfolio (vanilla): minimal hero, masonry image grid (mock), simple vanilla JS lightbox, category filter buttons, about section, booking form. Palette: sophisticated colors [SUGGEST], elegant typography.

prompts.title: Tech Blog
prompts.text: Develop tech blog (vanilla): featured post hero, blog post card grid (title, excerpt, meta: author/date/read-time, tags), sidebar (categories, popular posts), dark/light toggle JS, newsletter signup form. Data: JSON blog posts file.

prompts.title: Personal Blog
prompts.text: Create minimal personal blog (vanilla): typography-first design, post list with dates/excerpts, tag cloud, about section, single post page with prev/next navigation. Mobile-optimized, no clutter. Data: JSON for posts.

prompts.title: Analytics Dashboard
prompts.text: Build analytics dashboard (vanilla): 4-6 KPI cards (numbers + trend arrows), line chart (time trends), bar chart (comparisons), data table with JS sort/filter, date range picker. Mock data: JSON. Responsive, professional color design.

prompts.title: Project Management Board
prompts.text: Create Kanban board (vanilla): 3-4 draggable columns (To Do, In Progress, Review, Done), draggable task cards via vanilla JS, detail popup modal, priority badges, assignee avatars, add button for new tasks. Persistence: localStorage JSON.

prompts.title: Multi-step Form
prompts.text: Develop multi-step form (vanilla): 3-4 steps, progress bar, real-time JS field validation, prev/next navigation, final summary step, success page. Smooth transition effects. Mobile-friendly. Save progress in sessionStorage.

prompts.title: Interactive Calculator
prompts.text: Create interactive calculator (e.g. mortgage/loan, vanilla): input range sliders, real-time result updates, formula visualization, comparison chart (different rates), PDF export button via JS. Clear design, intuitive UX.

prompts.title: Newsletter Template
prompts.text: Build HTML email newsletter template (table-based): logo header, hero image, 3-4 content sections (text + thumbnail), multicolor CTA buttons, social links footer, unsubscribe link. Responsive for email clients (Outlook, Gmail, etc).

prompts.title: Transactional Email
prompts.text: Create transactional email template (order confirmation, table-based HTML): header order details, order summary table, shipping info, tracking button, help/support footer. Email client compatible, brand colors, responsive.

prompts.title: API Documentation
prompts.text: Develop API docs (vanilla): sticky sidebar navigation, endpoint sections (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), code examples with syntax highlight (highlight.js ok), auth guide, client-side search box. Dark/light theme. Responsive.

prompts.title: Product Docs Site
prompts.text: Build product documentation site (vanilla): sidebar tree nav with collapse, markdown-rendered content (or structured HTML), breadcrumbs, per-page TOC, prev/next nav buttons, search. Classic docs layout, responsive.

prompts.title: Browser Mini-game
prompts.text: Create browser mini-game (vanilla): [CHOOSE: Snake/Memory/Tetris/2048], Canvas or DOM, score counter, high score in localStorage, start/pause/restart buttons, game over modal. Responsive, mobile-playable.

prompts.title: Quiz Game
prompts.text: Build quiz game (vanilla): question cards, multiple choice answers, optional timer per question, score tracking, progress bar, final results screen with share button, replay option. Data: JSON questions. Smooth transitions.

prompts.title: Restaurant Website
prompts.text: Develop restaurant website (vanilla): fullscreen hero image, digital menu with categories + items + prices, reservation form (JS date/time picker), photo gallery with lightbox, embedded Google Maps, contact info + WhatsApp button.

prompts.title: Local Business Site
prompts.text: Create local business website (vanilla): 4-6 services overview cards, business hours, team profiles, customer testimonials carousel, location map embed, contact form + WhatsApp. Warm & approachable design, responsive.
